# Nanded City Township Pune

> Comprehensive Residential Platform for Nanded City Township Pune across 700 Acres on Sinhagad Road.
> Website: https://www.nanded-city.in/
> Authorised Marketing Partner: MahaRERA A031262401295 (PropSmart Realty)
> Advisory Contact: +91 7744009295 | propsmartrealty@gmail.com

Nanded City is a 700-acre integrated, self-sustainable township located on Sinhagad Road, Pune - 411041, Maharashtra, India. Developed by Nanded City Development & Construction Company Limited (NCDCCL) led by Satish Magar, the township houses over 15,000 families across 20 distinct residential clusters and branded NA bungalow plots. PropSmart Realty (Authorised Marketing Partner: MahaRERA A031262401295) facilitates verified property advisory, floor plans, and site visits.

## Residential Clusters

- [Saajgiri](https://www.nanded-city.in/cluster/saajgiri/): 3 BHK Luxury High-Rise residences from ₹1.05 Cr onwards. MahaRERA: PR1260002501621.
- [Harmony](https://www.nanded-city.in/cluster/harmony/): 3.5 & 4.5 BHK Royal Palace Apartments from ₹1.85 Cr onwards. MahaRERA: P52100055134.
- [Melody Phase 1, 2, 3](https://www.nanded-city.in/cluster/melody-1/): Branded NA Bungalow Plots from ₹1.35 Cr onwards. MahaRERA: P52100051948.
- [Rhythm Villa Plots](https://www.nanded-city.in/cluster/rhythm-1/): Villa NA Plots from ₹1.45 Cr onwards. MahaRERA: P52100051950.
- [Aalaap-I](https://www.nanded-city.in/cluster/aalaap-1/): 2 & 3 BHK Urban Residences from ₹78 L onwards. MahaRERA: P52100051234.
- [Pancham Phase 1 & 2](https://www.nanded-city.in/cluster/pancham/): 2 BHK Family Homes from ₹65 L onwards. MahaRERA: P52100000288.
- [Bageshree](https://www.nanded-city.in/cluster/bageshree/): 2 BHK Modern Towers from ₹58 L onwards. Ready to Move.
- [Asawari](https://www.nanded-city.in/cluster/asawari/): 2 & 3 BHK High-Rise resale apartments from ₹75 L onwards.
- [Sargam](https://www.nanded-city.in/cluster/sargam/): 2 & 3 BHK High-Rise resale flats from ₹80 L onwards.
- [Kalashree](https://www.nanded-city.in/cluster/kalashree/): 2.5 & 3 BHK Lake-Facing resale homes from ₹85 L onwards.

## Interactive Tools & Calculators

- [Cluster Comparison Tool](https://www.nanded-city.in/compare/): Side-by-side comparison of all residential clusters, floor plans, and amenities.
- [Commute & Flyover Transit Corridor Matrix](https://www.nanded-city.in/connectivity/): Travel times, Sinhagad Road Flyover access, and transit routes.
- [EMI & Stamp Duty Calculator](https://www.nanded-city.in/emi-calculator/): Monthly home loan EMI calculation with Maharashtra 7% stamp duty calibration.
- [Brochure & MahaRERA Vault](https://www.nanded-city.in/brochures/): Download official brochures and view MahaRERA QR certificates.
- [Township Directory](https://www.nanded-city.in/township-directory/): Directory of essential services, schools, and hospitals in Nanded City.
- [Master Plan & Sector Map](https://www.nanded-city.in/master-plan/): 700-Acre sector layout, green corridors, and spine roads.
- [Floor Plans & Blueprints](https://www.nanded-city.in/floor-plans/): Detailed 2, 2.5, 3, 3.5 & 4.5 BHK unit blueprints.
- [Resale & Rental Guide](https://www.nanded-city.in/resale-rental-guide/): 2026 pricing benchmarks and rental yields.

## Core Infrastructure

- [Master Infrastructure Guide](https://www.nanded-city.in/infrastructure/): Water security (captive WTP), zero-liquid-discharge STP, 22kV dual-feeder electrical substations, 24x7 security, and sports complexes.
- [All Residential Projects](https://www.nanded-city.in/projects/): Complete directory of 20 residential clusters in Nanded City Pune.
- [Sinhagad Road Location Guide](https://www.nanded-city.in/near/sinhagad-road/): Property market analysis for Sinhagad Road and surrounding Pune micro-markets.
- [Knowledge Center & FAQs](https://www.nanded-city.in/faq/): Answers to questions regarding buying, renting, maintenance, and amenities.
- [Marathi Portal](https://www.nanded-city.in/mr/): Nanded City Township guide and residential documentation in Marathi.
- [Contact & Site Visits](https://www.nanded-city.in/contact/): Schedule an in-person guided site visit and walkthrough.
